upstream: DfT BODS SIRI-VM datafeed, London bbox
method: 3 direct polls for size; cadence from the local run: 24 requests in 360 s, median logged interval 14.97 s
caveat: measured 23:33 BST: only 3221 of 8273 elements were newer than 5 min (the rest are dropped by the parser), and the local run kept 3314 vehicles per poll; by day the kept count is about 9-10 thousand (memory-fit.json, by hour)

stream: bus positions, after de-duplication (new fixes only)
trigger: every bus poll; a fix is kept when RecordedAtTime changed
method: trace file written by the local run: 53364 lines, 4620262 bytes in 52 polls
caveat: night-time; the first poll writes every vehicle once, which inflates the mean by about 6 %

trigger: leaderboard sampler, 15 s, through the 8 s cache shared with /api/arrivals
method: 3 direct polls for size; cadence from the local run quiet phase (24 requests in 360 s); undici counted 204368 wire bytes per request
caveat: 327 distinct vehicleIds behind 4487 predictions at 23:35 BST; production served 5187 predictions in 4787457 bytes 15 min earlier

stream: train arrival predictions (one viewer polling at 10 s)
trigger: sampler + viewer misses on the 8 s cache; floor is one fetch per 8 s however many viewers
method: cadence from the local run viewer phase (41 requests in 360 s)
caveat: in production Cloudflare sits in front, so viewer count does not translate one-to-one into origin requests

trigger: nr-sampler.ts: one of 17 hubs per 15 s leaderboard sample, 45 s cache
method: bytes and cadence from the local run (undici counters, response is not compressed so wire = decoded); records from production /api/nr-board for VIC and CLJ
caveat: upstream answered HTTP 500 for WAT throughout (production /api/nr-board?crs=WAT also 500); the proxy reshapes a board to about 14237 bytes before serving it

stream: rail line status, 7-day window with detail
method: 1 direct poll for size; cadence from the local run quiet phase (3 in 360 s)
caveat: one viewer adds /api/disruptions fetches on top (90 s poll): 7 requests in 360 s in the viewer phase

stream: rail line status by mode (no detail)
trigger: status recorder, every 2 min (status-recorder.ts pollMs), alongside the window form
method: local run, undici counters (wire bytes only)

trigger: on demand: /api/road-disruptions, 120 s cache; plus the archive recorder every 6 h
method: 1 direct poll for size; interval is the cache TTL, i.e. the fastest the upstream can be asked
caveat: with no viewer only the 6-hourly recorder asks: none in the quiet phase, 2 in 360 s with one viewer

trigger: on demand: /api/bus-stop-closures, viewers poll at 300 s
method: 1 direct poll for size; interval is the viewer poll interval
caveat: stop ids missing from the baked gazetteer cost extra /StopPoint/{ids} lookups: 14 on the first request of the first local run, none once the resolved ids had been written back

trigger: on demand: /api/tide-gauges, 300 s cache; one refresh = 1 readings + 10 per-station requests
method: local run viewer phase, undici counters (wire bytes); records from production
caveat: plus a 24 KB station catalogue once an hour; decoded size not measured
inbound message rate and bytes NOT measured: the stream is a WebSocket and neither the log nor undici's request counters see its frames

trigger: on demand: /api/aircraft, 4 s cache, viewers poll at 5 s; no rate given, the feed is down
method: size of the body production serves; both upstreams answered HTTP 403 from the measuring machine
caveat: NOT LIVE: production answers x-cache: stale and the body's own timestamp is 2026-08-21, 39 days old. The size is that of the last good response, not of today's traffic
Dubai runs this feed: 213 stations, 19 KB served (endpoints-dubai.csv); upstream size not measured
